name: Tank
summary: Generic cartoon military tank in side view with tracks, turret and long gun; no insignia. For action scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tracks stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 900 px wide and 300 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = roadwheels turn and the tank rocks (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the gun points left

author: krakujs
